The modifications across the three files are interconnected, focusing on the PTP (Precision Time Protocol) initialization process. The changes in `qede_main.c` ensure that PTP is enabled every time the device is probed, which is a prerequisite for the subsequent changes in `qede_ptp.h` and `qede_ptp.c`. 

The removal of the `init_tc` parameter in both `qede_ptp.h` and `qede_ptp.c` signifies a shift towards always initializing the cyclecounter and timecounter, which is crucial for maintaining PTP functionality after device recovery. Additionally, the clearing of the Tx pending bit in `qede_ptp.c` enhances the robustness of the PTP implementation by ensuring that the state is correctly reset when PTP is disabled. 

Overall, these modifications collectively address the issue of PTP becoming non-functional after device recovery by ensuring proper initialization and cleanup processes are always executed.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the PTP cyclecounter and timecounter being initialized only during the first probing of the device and not re-initialized after device recovery. This led to PTP functionality becoming non-functional after recovery, as the necessary initialization steps were skipped. The cleanup during removal did not account for re-initialization upon re-probing, resulting in a failure to properly set up PTP after recovery.
        
        Commit message:
        net: qede: fix PTP initialization on recovery

Currently PTP cyclecounter and timecounter are initialized only on
the first probing and are cleaned up during removal. This means that
PTP becomes non-functional after device recovery.
Fix this by unconditional PTP initialization on probing and clearing
Tx pending bit on exiting.

Fixes: ccc67ef50b90 ("qede: Error recovery process")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Lobakin <alobakin@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Igor Russkikh <irusskikh@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Michal Kalderon <michal.kalderon@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qede/qede_main.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qede/qede_main.c
index 756c05eb96f3..f6ff31e73ebe 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qede/qede_main.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qede/qede_main.c
@@ -1229,7 +1229,7 @@ static int __qede_probe(struct pci_dev *pdev, u32 dp_module, u8 dp_level,
 
 	/* PTP not supported on VFs */
 	if (!is_vf)
-		qede_ptp_enable(edev, (mode == QEDE_PROBE_NORMAL));
+		qede_ptp_enable(edev);
 
 	edev->ops->register_ops(cdev, &qede_ll_ops, edev);
